name: Comic Con Panamá
blurb: Panama's annual pop-culture convention at the Panama Convention Center, with Artist Alley, a cosplay contest and a collectibles zone.
notes: The seed URL (comicconpanama.com) is dead — the host account is suspended ('Account Suspended' / cgi-sys/suspendedpage.cgi). The real official site is comiccon.com.pa; url corrected to that.
